requires: Certified frozen dataset accepted by distress.dataset.load_frozen
shared_conditions: identical eligible sample IDs and labels
same stopping rule and epoch budget
same declared validation-only tuning trial budget

uncertainty.bootstrap_scope: conditional on each fitted model pair; same sampled firms and multiplicity in both models
uncertainty.seed_reporting: per-seed scores and paired differences, mean and standard deviation; no pseudo-replication of firm-years
uncertainty.formal_significance: Do not claim omnibus significance from unadjusted intervals; specify a primary comparison family and multiplicity procedure before any formal tests.

temporal_reporting: Pooled 2024-2025 and separate year metrics; fixed trained model for both years. This is not rolling retraining.
not_established_by_these_tests: causal or semantic interpretation of attention weights
faithful causal interpretation of gate weights
earlier textual warning before numerical deterioration
prediction_and_log_requirements: sample ID, firm ID, origin, label and probability for every model and seed
dataset manifest hash and checkpoint hash
epoch-level training and validation losses, selected epoch and stopping epoch
feature panel, missingness masks and fitted transformation parameters
